entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF-886134.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF-886134... I see it here. This is for the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered on December 6th. Is that correct?
I can certainly look into that for you. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They're just terrible. I've tried them on a few rides and they've given me horrible blisters. The positioning for the cleats feels wrong, too. They're unwearable.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we aim for. Just to confirm, you'd like to start a return for a full refund?

Of course. Let me just confirm the return eligibility... Okay, yes. Standard items like these cycling shoes have a 90-day return window, and you are well within that period. I can process this return for you immediately.

I've gone ahead and initiated that for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be issued. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble you've had, I've added a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase.
You're most welcome. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
